content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only the single purchased item ID (1784) without access to transaction data, co-purchase patterns, or a product catalog.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 1784. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
